game_title: Trace Table Race – Archery Yard Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in The Kingdom – Archery Yard, the garrison archery yard: the knight must handle shadow scouts while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Trace Table Race: Fill a trace table showing each variable after every line of a mini program.
theme: The Kingdom – Archery Yard: the garrison archery yard
core_gameplay_loop: In Archery Yard, repeat each round: Fill a trace table showing each variable after every line of a mini program. Each round, shadow scouts strike the wall banner, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the trace_rows_correct value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the wall banner from shadow scouts in Archery Yard: keep the trace_rows_correct meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 24-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: trace_rows_correct drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 24-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 1 (intro tier): Trace Table Race
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Trace Table Race' (Week 1 slot 14), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Archery Yard'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trace_rows_correct changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow scouts in Archery Yard.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 24 seconds while trace_rows_correct > 0.
